preserve.what: The published snapshot shape and sanitiser in packages/core/src/status/model.ts and publish.ts (sanitiseIncident, buildSnapshot, signature) stay unchanged; incident writes only use existing columns.
The incident table checks and grants (packages/db/migrations/20261025050000_status_incident.sql): no new migration, no DELETE; resolved_at is set exactly when state is resolved.
Existing console pages, requireStaff behaviour (apps/admin/lib/staff.ts) and the sources/flags actions and their audit tests; support role capabilities unchanged.
system.status.poll (case-watch) and system.status.publish job definitions and registry tests are untouched.

decisions.choice: One audit action 'incident.changed' (security, fail-closed) with metadata {incident_id, change: created|updated|resolved, old/new state} instead of three actions.
New capability 'status' for ops and admin rather than reusing 'flags' or 'adapters'; support denied via requireStaff notFound.
decisions.justification: Capabilities are one per nav item (apps/admin/lib/roles.ts:14-27); incident publishing is an ops duty like sources/flags.

decisions.choice: core status gains a dependency on audit (CORE_DOMAIN_DEPENDENCIES) and writes only through audit's index.
decisions.justification: Sources does the same (core-domains.js:78); cross-domain imports go through index.ts per CLAUDE.md.
